description: OPTeam is published by OPTeam (listed by DIREKTION). OPTeam is a web application for exploring fire-service resource allocation and operational scenarios. Its stated coverage is Configurable fire-and-rescue territories; developed in France. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The full-resource cost is unknown and requires provider clarification. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. The page mixes existing functions with planned fatigue-model additions; the latter are not recorded as delivered. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
